slides.texte_overlay:
Small things that make you
subtly attractive to everyone
A relaxed smile that reaches your eyes. Not a forced grin, a real one. People are drawn to someone who looks like he's genuinely enjoying the moment.
Being calm when plans fall apart. Missed train, cancelled table, sudden rain. The man who shrugs and finds a plan B is the one everyone wants to be around.
Asking good questions and listening to the answers. Curiosity about other people is one of the most attractive qualities a man can have, at any age.
Taking care of your body without obsessing. Regular training, good sleep, healthy food. A body that looks cared for says you respect yourself and the people around you.
Before: nothing to say beyond small talk. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and a curiosity that makes every conversation more interesting.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: nothing to say beyond small talk. After: five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Now every conversation is better.

slides.texte_overlay: Being kind to people who can't do anything for you. The waiter, the cleaner, the stranger asking for directions. Everyone notices how you treat them.
Having passions you can talk about with fire in your eyes. Music, a sport, cooking, history. Enthusiasm is contagious, and contagious energy is magnetic.
